kind: other
depth: focused
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_iam_role" "this" {
  for_each           = var.roles
  name               = each.key
  path               = try(each.value.path, null)
  assume_role_policy = "{}"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "this" {
  name                      = "q"
  message_retention_seconds = 60
}

variable "roles" {
  type = any
}
